We help DTC and B2B brands turn their Shopify Plus stores into revenue engines. 

At LATECH, I lead our demand generation and partnership strategy, connecting high-growth brands with the technical expertise they need to scale. What we do: Shopify Plus builds, migrations (from Magento, Salesforce, Custom), CRO, headless commerce, and POS implementation. 

Results we’ve delivered: +35% conversion rate for Gymkhana after migration, Schneider Electric B2B portal handling $44K+ orders, unified POS architecture recovering 7% lost revenue for beauty brands. 

If your ecommerce platform is holding back your growth, let’s talk.
